reason: The official HM Land Registry guidance is directly readable without login and materially changes the method from boundary-law semantics to the target-specific information-retrieval workflow. It identifies map/title-number search paths and the available property summary/register/plan documents, but also states that title plans show general boundaries and that HM Land Registry rarely holds specific boundary ownership information. The verified lineage contains no target-specific title/register/plan/deed or determined-boundary package, so no exact canonical parcel geometry/bbox is asserted. Spatial retrieval/join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
